label: Instant asset write-off limit (aggregated turnover under $10 million)
notes: The table gives no end date. The ATO legislation update, checked on 28 September 2026, confirms the $20,000 limit is permanent from 1 July 2026 for eligible small businesses: https://www.ato.gov.au/about-ato/new-legislation/in-detail/businesses/20000-dollars-instant-asset-write-off. For the full-cost deduction, each eligible depreciating asset must cost less than $20,000. Separate rules cover later additions to an asset's cost; other conditions and exclusions apply.
